checkpoints.description: [1/2] Align free-cash color with cashflow burden state

impact_assessment.why: Vision review of the populated demo dashboard found a green 0₺ free-cash figure next to a red high-burden warning (107.8% of income), a semantic contradiction (G-003 functional/usable).
impact_assessment.benefits: Free-cash total now reuses the computed burden color, so zero surplus under high burden reads red; before/after vision reviews on demo data approved (94 -> 97).
impact_assessment.risks: Single-line JS render change; no data, i18n or layout change; populated and empty states both verified; 107/107 tests pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: npm test 107/107, ui verify + ui finish --reviewed, vision analysis of both demo screenshots, check --strict 4/4.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Make health score reflect cashflow burden

impact_assessment.why: Vision review of the populated dashboard found a green 'excellent' health pill contradicting a 107.8% obligation burden and 0₺ free cash (G-003 functional/usable).
impact_assessment.benefits: Health score now considers burden (>65% critical, >40% warning) even with safe utilization; failing-first test added; before/after vision reviews approved (93 -> 97).
impact_assessment.risks: Added 5th optional parameter with default 0 so existing calls unchanged; Turkish caption literals match existing style; burden-free states keep prior behavior; 108/108 tests pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first test confirmed 1 failure before implementation, then 108/108 pass; ui verify + ui finish --reviewed; vision analysis; check --strict 4/4.
